core: Both communities produce the items in an evaluation benchmark by having a model (a generator) automatically create the task specifications, rather than having a human author each task by hand.
quote_1: a model was given the old benchmark's easy tier and asked to generate harder variants, no human wrote a single one from scratch.
quote_2: A ⟦T2⟧ produced 2,160 task specifications from a weaker generator, with executable checks withheld from the evaluated agents.
